main_text.l: [woodcut illustration: house with winds, not transcribed as text]

l.i: O Biectis Ventos foribus, clausisque fenestris,
Esqne etiam tota mors prohibere domo.
Aft aures, oculisq3, ha sunt Utrinque decebat

page.notes: The first verse line has a large decorative initial O; the printed text is partly worn and some letters in the italic verse are uncertain (e.g. "Biectis", "Esqne", "Aft", "oculisq3"), so these readings are doubtful. The woodcut is a picture and is not transcribed. "Faber" stands at lower right as a signature-like word and is copied as printed.
